title: Consent-posture adoption: container kickoff as the autonomous dispatch vehicle, no gate-disabling (SO ruling 2026-08-02) + downstream edits

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OperatorDirectiveApplied{directive: consent-posture-container-vehicle} — SO RULING 2026-08-02. THE RULING: vsdd's autonomous dispatch vehicle is CONTAINER-BASED crosslink kickoff (kickoff run --container), which is non-interactive (docker run -d = no TTY = the folder-trust dialog cannot render). Gate-disabling (--skip-permissions / --dangerously-skip-permissions) is NOT ADOPTED — the container's non-interactivity IS the mechanism, not disabling approval gates. This is the pure approve-then-dispatch model: the operator's dispatch act is the consent; the container has no interactive gate to bypass. RETIRES the open question 'may headless dispatch run gate-disabled?' with a definitive NO. Grounded in dollspace-gay/crosslink#55's refined diagnosis (container path verified working headless end-to-end; tmux/plan path structurally blocked by TTY-gated folder-trust). ACTIONABILITY: the container vehicle is stand-up-able — image ghcr.io/dollspace-gay/crosslink-agent (our mirror's default, container.rs:43) with a local 'just build-image' fallback (the :local convention); forecast-bio/crosslink#576 image-publish CLOSED-completed ('should be good now'), dollspace-gay publication to confirm at Phase-5 build time. DOWNSTREAM EDITS ROUTED (deferred past the feat/820 merge to avoid branch churn; execute when the branch state is clean): (1) AFFORDANCE MAP — flip the autonomous-execution binding from container-BLOCKED/attended-tmux-working-posture to container-ADOPTED; tmux/local declined (interactive, stalls headless); gate-disabling explicitly not the mechanism (map recorded-pair discipline, DE lens). (2) DEVIATION REGISTRY — entry 5 (container-kickoff-blocked-posture): re-scope its trigger from '#9/#10 closed' to 'container image usable' (#9/#10 done via PR #64; the residual is image availability); entry 1 (manual-dispatch-fallback): trigger_context names the container vehicle as the adopted exit once the dispatch integration is built (Phase 5/6) + image usable — stays standing (integration unbuilt). Both SO re-arms under this disposition. (3) CONTRACT — the dispatch-posture language (attended/autonomous; the affordance map member's autonomous-execution binding) FOLDS INTO THE UNIFICATION cycle per the prior triage ruling (no separate amendment). (4) PHASE 5 1b — the dispatch design targets the container vehicle (kickoff run --container + the swarm equivalent), non-interactive, no gate-disabling; pairs with the reviewer-roles-as-agent-types adoption. (5) UPSTREAM — support dollspace-gay/crosslink#55's recommended fix (make kickoff plan non-interactive OR add --container to plan) since the PLAN path (gap analysis) stays tmux-blocked; note on #55.
